transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Tuesday, October 27. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Harry Kane wins 2026 Ballon d'Or, becomes 1st player to claim two awards in one night. Harry Kane made history at the 2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony, becoming the first Englishman in 25 years to win football's most prestigious individual honour. The Bayern Munich striker also claimed the Gerd Müller Trophy, completing a historic double after scoring 73 goals for club and country. His extraordinary campaign marks a defining moment in his career and English football history. 'Not trying to reinvent the wheel': Luke Williams backs MI's core for WPL 2027. Mumbai Indians missed the Women's Premier League playoffs last season after injuries and illness disrupted their combinations and close games slipped away. New head coach Luke Williams believes the franchise can return to contention without making wholesale changes. With Harmanpreet Kaur continuing as captain, Williams wants to retain the core, fine-tune player roles and target the right additions at the October 28 auction as Mumbai look to bounce back. Microsoft extends buyouts to 60,000 staff in India, US, UK and Canada. Microsoft is offering buyouts to around 60,000 employees in India, the US, the UK and Canada under a new Voluntary Exit Offer, announced in a memo from Chief People Officer Amy Coleman. Open up to level 70, the offer has no age, tenure or performance criteria and mirrors standard severance. Employees have until early December to decide. The move follows 4,800 Microsoft layoffs in July. Delaware sank 180-foot ship bought for $1 to create artificial reef. In a strategic move to enhance marine ecosystems, the retired fishing vessel F/V Calcasieu Pass has been sunk off the Delaware coast to function as an artificial reef. This initiative, aimed at supporting diverse aquatic species, involved meticulously clearing hazardous materials before the sinking. Environmental authorities will oversee the area, monitoring the growth and health of the marine habitats it spawns in the years to come. Lawrence Bishnoi shifted to high-security Ahmedabad jail block housing 2008 blasts convicts. Gangster Lawrence Bishnoi is learnt to have been recently shifted to "Do sau kholi", a specialised high-security block at Ahmedabad's Sabarmati Central Jail housing 200 dangerous inmates accused of terrorism and other heinous offences, sources say. 7 civilians killed in Jordan strike on Syrian militants in retaliation to church attack. Jordan carried out airstrikes against armed groups in southern Syria on Tuesday in retaliation for a deadly attack on a Greek Orthodox Church in the Jordanian city of Karak last week, with Syrian authorities reporting at least 7 civilian deaths. California farmer's email experiment triples walnut crop's gross revenue. A walnut farmer in California revolutionized his sales with a targeted email marketing campaign. Reaching out to prior cherry customers, he uncovered 300 interested buyers for his walnuts. This approach resulted in his gross revenue tripling against wholesale prices, proving that even a small customer base can boost income stability. Consequently, many farmers are now embracing direct sales strategies to lessen financial uncertainties. Michigan woman buys 128-year-old church for $45K, turns it into home. Whitney Anderson, 45, bought a 128-year-old abandoned church in Michigan for $45,000 and is turning it into her dream home. She has spent an estimated $194,000 on renovations since June 2024 and hopes to complete most of the work by 2028. As costs could reach $400,000, Anderson describes the project as the biggest gamble of her life. June 2025 decision to hold SIR taken unanimously, EC tells SC. The Election Commission Monday filed an affidavit in SC that the chief election commissioner and the two election commissioners had unanimously taken the decision on June 24, 2025 to conduct nationwide SIR of electoral rolls and that there was no difference of opinion. Bill Gates says Meta's Muse is the first great consumer AI product, but has one worry. Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates has called Meta's Muse "the first truly great consumer AI product" in an interview with The Verge, revealing he congratulated chief AI officer Alexandr Wang on the personal AI agent. Gates said Muse stands out because it actually gets tasks done, but warned that open-weight AI models with removable safeguards are irresponsible, a week after Meta released its own Muse Spark Open. Asin's daughter, 8, can speak 12 languages, says dad; no TV or phones at home. Asin Thottumkal and Rahul Sharma deliberately choose to raise their daughter Arin in a tech-free environment, opting for books over screens. By fostering a love for reading, they encourage a deep learning experience. At only eight years old, Arin impressively communicates in 12 languages, highlighting her parents' commitment to her education.
